name: Effy
source:
Don't let that sweet face fool you - Effy is a ruthless pursuer of her desires. She knows she's cute, so she wields it like a weapon.

Too clever for her own good, she uses her smarts to manipulate and control others.

Effy seeks out admirers wherever she goes, and she isn't satisfied with just a smile. She wants all the love from everyone. Especially her sister, Stephanie.

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Effy]DumbKoala[/url]]
